description: Supports transfer students’ transition to Oregon State by introducing them to the university’s mission and goals, sharing the tools and resources it offers its students, and assisting students in developing strategies for their personal and academic success and well-being.
registration_restrictions: Enrollment limited to students with the Upper Division Transitions attribute.
